rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORdoubt
Exhibition name: Johannesburg Sun
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 1987).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 1988 as 'Johannesburg Sun'.
rows.Bloom: Golden-yellow. Moderate fragrance. 22 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long buds.
rows.Habit: Tall, upright. Glossy, dark green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Vigorous.
rows.Notes: Zimbabwe patent application No. 8836 on April 25, 1988
